changelog:
- Initial release of "risk-grade-set" skill.
- Enables creation of a 4–8 still risk grade pack from user-supplied risk-grade definitions.
- One still per named grade; supports use in graphics, cards, and classification sets.
- Strictly uses only user-supplied grade names and definitions—does not invent or fill missing data.
- Provides clear pack planning, user confirmation, and detailed workflow for generation, review, and delivery.
- Integrates all Beatra operations through a bundled client for reliability and simple updates.
summary: Turn user-supplied risk-grade definitions into a four-to-eight still risk grade set. This risk grade still studio lays out each named grade as its own still. Use it for risk grade graphics, risk level cards, risk classification stills, and a risk grade pack.
